relationNotes: PcSkill/specialskills.txt is the skills1_full subset where LvlSetScript starts with \script\skill\special.
PcSkill/npcskills.txt is the skills1_full subset where LvlSetScript starts with \script\skill\npc plus SkillName contains boss.
Reference/ModSkills.txt is a separate PC table with a different 114-column/ragged layout; it is not the full skills1 table, though skills1_full also contains rows with SkillId >= 1216.
